_comment: Documented exceptions to the npm audit gate. Each entry MUST have a justification + expiry. Past-expiry entries fail the build. See SUPPLY_CHAIN.md § Allowlist for the policy.
_policy: An entry exists because the fix is non-trivial (major-version bump with breaking changes, transitive in a build-only path, or no upstream fix yet). Each entry is a written commitment to revisit by the expiry date. The CI gate prints the days-to-expiry for every active entry as a forcing function.
_cleared_2026-05-25_scan: The three 2026-05-09 baseline entries (next GHSA-ggv3-7p47-pfv8, lodash-es GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc, picomatch GHSA-3v7f-55p6-f55p) were the fix-vs-allowlist commitments behind the recurring [cve-scan] Source HIGH findings cluster (#1374 / #1555 / #1964 / #2265). They were CLEARED — not snoozed — by the dedicated remediation PR for #2265: next 16.1.6 -> 16.2.6 (semver-minor) plus a non-force `npm audit fix` for the lodash-es / picomatch transitives. `npm audit --audit-level=high` now exits 0, so no allowlist entry is required. Per SUPPLY_CHAIN.md § 3 the fix lands with its allowlist entries removed in the same commit.
